verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Marketing Emails API documents querying post-send statistics for one or more marketing emails through REST endpoints, so email-level performance data can be pulled programmatically. Nothing in the pack shows API access to campaign-level or workflow/flow performance metrics; the in-app dashboards don't count because the story is about API export. missing for 10: campaign-level metrics API, workflow/flow performance metrics API, documented bulk export or warehouse sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`, and include any filters as query parameters in your request
